tasks.task: Take in a new B2B client before touching the account

items.when: In the first talk with a new client, to collect the facts every later choice depends on
When the client says everyone is a buyer, to pin down one buyer with pains and goals
When the client has a customer list, to find the top fifth and what they share
When the client cannot say why a buyer should pick them over the real alternatives

tasks.task: Plan a LinkedIn campaign sized to deal value

items.when: When the offer and buyer are known and you need objective, audience, formats and budget
When LinkedIn is one of several paid social channels and you need the funnel across them
When you need campaign structure, targeting and bids written out for the build
When the plan jumps to tactics before the target and the goal are chosen
Before the plan is agreed, to compare two plans that split the budget and the weeks differently
Before any budget is set, to confirm the offer and the page the ads point to are live and work today

tasks.task: Set budget and target lead cost from deal size

items.when: Before setting or defending a budget, to derive lead cost targets from the client's numbers
When you must say how much spend a test needs before it can show a winner
When leads are cheap but weak, to work out cost per qualified lead and what friction to add
When CRM stages and spend are both to hand, to see the true cost of each stage

tasks.task: Build audiences from job titles and company lists

items.when: When you need the targeting set: titles, seniority, company size and exclusions
When customer data exists, to profile the best accounts before choosing filters
When the campaign needs a named account list with the reason each one fits

tasks.task: Write ad copy in three LinkedIn formats

items.when: When one offer and one buyer need a single image ad, a document ad and a conversation ad
When you have customer words and facts and want the buyer brief and first lines first
When one idea works, to get ten or more different angles with a test order
When the headline is flat, to get five short ones that each take a new angle
When the intro text is drafted, to score the first line and get fixes
Before upload, to flag lines that risk rejection and get safer rewrites
When the copy reads like a brochure and should sound like one person talking

tasks.task: Plan single image ads

items.when: When you have the facts and need the layout, image words and feed copy for one ad
When you want three or four layouts with text zones to compare
When a client quote is the strongest proof and should carry the ad
Before the images are briefed, to spread nine or more one-line concepts and mock up the strongest
When the ad is drafted, to score it against its landing page and get fixes
When the client's team will make the images from a template

tasks.task: Plan a document ad or carousel

items.when: When one selling idea must unfold over a few cards that each earn the next swipe
When the cover page needs a title, to try five angles before choosing
Before the slides are written, to test several different ideas for the document and pick the lead
When the pages are laid out, to trace where the eye goes and what to cut

tasks.task: Draft thought leader posts to sponsor

items.when: When buyers are slow and careful, to plan what the founder should say to earn trust
When a founder story or view must become a post the founder publishes
When the opening line is forgettable, to get three versions to choose from
Before the founder posts, to catch wording that reads as machine-written

tasks.task: Script a short B2B video ad

items.when: When you have the buyer and proof and want four script types, each with its opening
When the script should sound like a person talking and use only the buyer's words and facts
When the script is drafted, to find each weak line and get a fix

tasks.task: Design a lead gen form and the follow-up

items.when: When you need the form fields, wording and a plan for sales to call within a day
When marketing and sales disagree on what a good lead is and who acts on it
When form leads are not ready to talk and need follow-up emails first
When the form has results, to decide what to raise or cut and get a better form

tasks.task: Write the landing page behind the ads

items.when: When the campaign sends clicks to a page and it needs proof, answers and one ask
When the page opening must match the ad, to get five headlines with a pick
When the ad exists and the page must carry the same promise through
Before the page is written in full, to build three different first screens that match the ads
When the page is built, to check it in a real browser at phone and desktop width
Before the page is built, to confirm the form, demo booking or download it leads to works today

tasks.task: Choose the offer or lead magnet to promote

items.when: When the buyer has a costly problem and you need a useful thing to offer for a reply
When several lead magnets are possible, to list them and pick the best
When the offer is a webinar, to plan how to fill it, run it and follow up
When an offer is live, to get three changes that raise replies or cut weak ones
When the offer feels weak, to test it on four levers and get a stronger one
When the offer asks for a demo and gives the buyer nothing first

tasks.task: Set up the tag, conversions and the CRM link

items.when: When you must confirm the tag fires and conversions match what the CRM records
When what counts as a lead is agreed and tracking must be set up or repaired
When every ad link needs tags that the CRM and analytics can match
Each month, to catch broken tracking and double counts before they skew reports

tasks.task: Review a LinkedIn ads account from its exports

items.when: When you have Campaign Manager and demographics exports plus CRM data
When you want a second scored pass on tag, audiences, forms and creative
When results changed and you need the likely cause with how sure you can be

tasks.task: Find waste in a demographics export

items.when: After pasting a demographics export, to see which titles and companies take money for nothing
When you want wasted spend and standout campaigns named from the same exports
When you need to prove which segments reach qualified lead, not only form fill

tasks.task: Launch a new campaign

items.when: For a new campaign, a new offer or a rebuild after a review
When the launch needs the client's yes on budget, audience or the one-time action list
Before anything goes live, to check ads and page against the ad rules
Before the plan is sent, to have it read as the client would and list what is unclear

tasks.task: Run the weekly optimisation routine

items.when: Once a week on the same day, plus a deeper monthly look at pipeline
When ads have run for weeks, to catch tired ones early and brief replacements
When results are in by ad, to call keep, leave or replace and spot false winners
When the week's changes need the client's yes before you make them
In the monthly look, to see what the leads became in the sales pipeline

tasks.task: Plan creative tests a small budget can prove

items.when: When you need hooks, format picks and a variation plan for the next round
When the live ads feel alike, to group them by idea and score the sameness
When a test ends, to see if the difference is real at this volume

tasks.task: Report results and pipeline to the client

items.when: When you have two periods of totals and need the one-line answer and three actions
When the report should show cost per qualified lead and per deal, not per click
When LinkedIn and the CRM disagree on what the ads produced
When the client doubts the ads add anything, to plan a lift test sized to them
Before sending, to read the report as the client and list what they would question

tasks.task: Plan retargeting for a long sales cycle

items.when: When visitors do not convert, to order the ads they see next
When you know the reasons people leave, to get one ad per objection and a test order

tasks.task: Study competitors' ads and find the gaps

items.when: When you name the rivals and want their public ads and pages read, proof apart from guesses
When you have pasted rival ads and want the gaps turned into briefs

tasks.task: Run an account list campaign with sales

items.when: When sales and marketing need one agreed list of target accounts
When sales will follow the ads with an email, call and message per account
When you must set who acts when a target account engages

always.when: Before any ad or report states a number or client result, to check it can be traced

helpers.when: When LinkedIn is one part of a wider B2B funnel that needs planning end to end
When leads must flow into the CRM with stages, routing and offline conversions
When the landing page or lead magnet needs writing in full
When image ads or a document ad need designing, not only planning
When form leads need calling and qualifying within a day
When pipeline credit across channels needs a proper attribution study

gaps: No library item builds LinkedIn targeting: titles against functions and seniority, company lists, exclusions and audience size
No library item writes a LinkedIn document ad or conversation ad to the format limits; only the kit prompt does
No library item designs a LinkedIn Lead Gen Form inside its field and character limits, or drafts two form versions to test
No library item sets up the LinkedIn Insight Tag, Conversions API or offline conversion uploads; tracking items cover Google and Meta
No library item reads a demographics export for waste by title, seniority and company; only the kit prompt does
No library item keeps a LinkedIn account weekly the way the Google, Meta and TikTok keepers do
No library item picks which founder posts to sponsor as thought leader ads or sets up the permissions
No library item covers LinkedIn bidding, frequency and audience penetration choices
No library item writes a client change request for approval; only the kit prompt does
No library item plans an account list campaign that ties ad stages to sales touches by account tier
